items.title: Shared toggle preserves its accessible contract
items.precondition: Execution complete; signed-out app is available.
steps: Open a signed-out route and locate the existing navbar theme toggle.
Confirm its target-mode accessible label and pressed state.
items.expected: The existing navbar control retains its appearance and accessibility semantics while switching the shared theme.
items.evidence: User-validated 2026-08-18: Messenger uses its own control and retains the global profile control independently.
items.notes: Acceptance superseded the original shared-toggle scope.

items.title: Inbox dark mode toggle
steps: Locate the theme toggle beside Message settings and activate it with pointer and keyboard.
Confirm the visual mode, html.dark, and localStorage socmed-theme change.
items.expected: The inbox control changes the shared persistent theme immediately; the chosen mode survives reload, and Message settings still opens.
items.evidence: User-validated 2026-08-18: Messenger mode changes the full Messages screen without changing other routes.
items.notes: Acceptance superseded the original shared-toggle scope.

items.title: Thread-header dark mode toggle and chat-theme compatibility
items.precondition: Signed in with a conversation; test one default-theme and one custom-theme thread when available.
steps: Open /messages/:conversationId at desktop and narrow/mobile width.
Locate the compact theme control among Search, Customize chat theme, and conversation options.
Toggle the app mode in each thread, then exercise Search, chat-theme picker, and conversation options.
Check text and controls are readable in both app modes.
items.expected: All thread-header actions remain reachable, theme switching persists, and both default/custom chat-theme views remain usable and legible.
items.evidence: User-validated 2026-08-18: conversation header has no duplicate switch; dark chat-theme variants retain selected colors with improved contrast.
items.notes: Acceptance superseded the original thread-switch scope.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-18: npm run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run lint, and npm --prefix frontend run build all completed successfully.
items.notes: Frontend lint emitted six pre-existing warnings outside the changed files; Vite emitted its pre-existing large-chunk advisory.
